# NicheDE

NicheDE is a method that detects context dependent changes in gene
expression in spatial transcriptomic data. In particular, given an index
and a niche cell type, we define an (index,niche) niche gene as a gene
as a gene that is up or down-regulated in the index cell type when in
the presence of the niche cell type.  
NicheDE identifies (index,niche)+ genes by first characterizing a cell’s
neighborhood into a vector called the effective niche. Then, by
regressing gene expression on the effective niche,testing if certain
coefficients are equal to 0 is equivalent to determining if the gene is
an (index,niche) niche gene.  
For more information about this method please check out [the
manuscript](https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.1101/2023.01.03.522646v1?rss=1)

# Installation

You can install NicheDE with the following code

    Sys.setenv(R_REMOTES_NO_ERRORS_FROM_WARNINGS="true")
    install.packages("devtools")
    options(timeout=9999999)
    devtools::install_github("kaishumason/NicheDE") # install
    library(nicheDE)

# Tutorials

Click the link below for tutorials on using nicheDE  
[NicheDE Tutorial: All

# Citation

Kaishu Mason, Anuja Sathe, Paul Hess, Jiazhen Rong, Chi-Yun Wu, Emma
Furth, Hanlee P. Ji, Nancy Zhang Niche differential gene expression
analysis in spatial transcriptomics data identifies context-dependent
cell-cell interactions (Biorxiv 2023:
<https://doi.org/10.1101/2023.01.03.522646>)

## Downstream Analysis

Functions for Performing Downstream Analysis

- [`get_niche_DE_genes()`](https://kmason23.github.io/NicheDE/reference/get_niche_DE_genes.md)
  : Getniche genes for the given index and niche cell types at the
  desired test.level
- [`niche_DE_markers()`](https://kmason23.github.io/NicheDE/reference/niche_DE_markers.md)
  : Get Niche-DE marker genes(test)
- [`niche_LR_cell()`](https://kmason23.github.io/NicheDE/reference/niche_LR_cell.md)
  : Perform Niche-LR (Ligand receptor analysis) on single cell level
  data
- [`niche_LR_spot()`](https://kmason23.github.io/NicheDE/reference/niche_LR_spot.md)
  : Perform Niche-LR (Ligand receptor analysis) on spot level data
